note: Publisher schedule config, consumed by scripts/social-publish.mjs. Slot times are FIRST-GUESS defaults (no analytics existed when they were chosen): Pinterest early because pins are evergreen search objects and the morning slot catches EU browsing; Instagram feed at lunch and the carousel at the evening peak; TikTok just after, once the carousel is live. Revise against real per-platform analytics once a few weeks of data exist — this file is the only place the times live.

pinterest.note: board is the Pinterest board ID; unknown until the Pinterest account is connected. Set POSTIZ_PINTEREST_BOARD in the runner's deployment env (docs/social-apps-setup.md §Pinterest) — a null here with no env means Pinterest posts are skipped with a logged reason.

tiktok.note: SELF_ONLY until TikTok's content-posting audit passes (docs/social-apps-setup.md §TikTok); flip privacy_level to PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE after audit.
